faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Staff 3 recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Staff 3 position is 15th September 2026. Ensure you apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Staff 3 post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a Three Years Graduate degree in a relevant subject/field with three years of experience, or a Post Graduate degree in a relevant subject/field. For Engineering/IT/CS, a First Class Four Years Graduate Degree with three years of experience is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Staff 3 position is 35 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Staff 3 role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Staff 3 post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Staff 3 position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Staff 3 recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Staff 3 post?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. Details regarding the contract period can be found in the official notification.
